$description: DHCW Single Record Design System — Touch target size tokens. Establishes three tiers of interactive target sizing aligned to WCAG 2.2 AA requirements and the clinical-desktop context of the Single Record programme. Height (and equally width, for square targets) is the controlled dimension.

touch.$description: Global touch target primitives. Raw values in the Primitives Figma variable collection. Scoped to WIDTH_HEIGHT.

24.$description: Global: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum (SC 2.5.8). Requires ≥10px inactive spacing on all sides.

32.$description: Global: desktop compact target. Desktop mouse contexts only.

44.$description: Global: WCAG 2.2 AAA (SC 2.5.5). Required for all touch interfaces.

touch.$description: Semantic touch target tokens. Alias tier in the Single Record Figma variable collection.

default.$description: 44px. WCAG 2.2 AAA (SC 2.5.5). REQUIRED for all MAUI (touch) interactive elements — no exceptions. Strongly recommended as the default for Blazor desktop. Use this unless a compact variant is explicitly justified.

compact.$description: 32px. Desktop (Blazor) only — never use on MAUI. Permitted for secondary actions in genuinely dense layouts: row-level action icons, inline icon buttons in data tables. Requires documented rationale in the component spec. Must not be used for primary or destructive actions.

minimum.$description: 24px. WCAG 2.2 AA floor (SC 2.5.8) — only valid with the spacing exception: the target must have ≥10px of inactive space on all sides (total interactive area ≥44px). Desktop only. Absolute last resort for extreme-density contexts such as icon-only action columns in data grids. Document the spacing justification in the component spec.
